title: Primitive Types
objectives: Use an explicit primitive type annotation.

sections.title: Small values, clear types
sections.body: FREAK can infer many primitive types, and V3 also supports explicit annotations for common primitives.

sections.title: Words and integers
sections.source:
pilot callsign: word = "Shiranui"
pilot power: int = 9001
say callsign
say power

sections.title: Print a callsign and power
sections.prompt: Declare a `word` callsign of `Shiranui` and an `int` power of `9001`, then print both.
sections.starter:
pilot callsign: word = "_____"
pilot power: int = _____
say callsign
say power

questions.prompt: Which primitive type represents text in FREAK?

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: `word` stores text and `int` stores whole numbers.
